│    interactive programs such as git log, man, or vim.                        │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│                             More Operating Rules                             │
│                                                                              │
│  • Think and act step by step and explain your actions and reasoning.        │
│  • Break complex objectives into smaller sub-goals if necessary.             │
│  • Use tools to gather knowledge or verify assumptions before proceeding.    │
│  • If you call a tool it will be executed and results will be returned to    │
│    you.                                                                      │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭──────────────────── logging - approver - system_message ─────────────────────╮
│                                                                              │
│                                   Context                                    │
│                                                                              │
│  • You are a helpful agent part of a Multi Agent System that solves server   │
│    and command-line related tasks.                                           │
│  • You, all other agents and the user operate on the same system.            │
│  • Once the user provides a task, the Multi Agent System's goal is to        │
│    complete the task collaboratively, without returning to the user for      │
│    clarification.- The chat history includes the user's task, progress       │
│    summaries, and information from previous agents, such as previous         │
│    sub-task plans, feedback, executed steps, exploration details and more.   │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│                               Task Description                               │
│                                                                              │
│  • Your role is the "Approver" agent of the Multi Agent System.              │
│  • Your job is to determine if the agents have done enough work on the task. │
│  • Make your decision based on all information gathered and the actions      │
│    performed by previous agents.                                             │
│  • Be critical and selective, approve only what you are completely sure of.  │
│  • If you decide that the task was not solved successfully, briefly explain  │
│    why and include the tag '[refiner]'.                                      │
│  • If you decide that not enough testing was done to ensure the task is      │
│    fully and successfully completed, briefly explain why and add the tag     │
│    '[tester]'.                                                               │
│  • If you decide that sufficient work was done, just reply briefly with the  │
│    tag '[summarizer]'.                                                       │
│  • Make one of the three decisions and include its tag in your response.     │

│ Notes about the manifest format (as implemented)                             │
│                                                                              │
│  • manifest.json layout (JSON):                                              │
│     • version: integer                                                       │
│     • created_by: "compress.py"                                              │
│     • root_input: absolute path to input dir used when creating the manifest │
│     • entries: list of:                                                      │
│        • original_path: path relative to input_dir                           │
│        • size: original size in bytes                                        │
│        • chunks: list of chunk objects:                                      │
│           • path: relative filename under the file's target output directory │
│             (currently the filename)                                         │
│           • size: bytes                                                      │
│           • sha256: checksum of the chunk file                               │
│                                                                              │
│ Next steps for full implementation (these will be done later or by the next  │
│ agent)                                                                       │
│                                                                              │

│    MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR children per directory (this must account for both    │
│    files and subdirectories created by the layout).                          │
│  • Implement robust splitting in compress.py: read large files and split     │
│    into chunk files <= MAX_FILE_BYTES and record each chunk's relative path, │
│    size, and sha256 in the manifest.                                         │
│  • Implement reassembly in decompress.py: read manifest chunks, locate each  │
│    chunk file under the resharded directory, concatenate them into the       │
│    original file path (relative to where user wants reconstruction           │
│    performed), and verify sizes and sha256 checksums.                        │
│  • Optionally add safeguards: transactional writes (write to temporary files │
│    then rename), checks for existing files to avoid overwrites without       │
│    explicit user consent, and progress logging.                              │
│  • Add unit or integration tests including a test that creates an            │

│                                                                              │
│ import sys import os import json import hashlib from pathlib import Path     │
│ from typing import List, Dict, Any                                           │
│                                                                              │
│ MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR = 30 MAX_FILE_BYTES = 15 * 1024 * 1024  # 15 MB          │
│                                                                              │
│ def ensure_dir(path: Path) -> None: path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)  │
│                                                                              │
│ def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with             │
│ path.open('rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):          │
│ h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ def enumerate_input_files(input_dir: Path) -> List[Path]: """Return a list   │
│ of file paths (relative to input_dir) to process.                            │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  This currently walks the directory tree and lists files in a                │
│  deterministic order (sorted by path).&quot;&quot;&quot;                     │
│  files = []                                                                  │
│  for p in sorted(input_dir.rglob(&#x27;*&#x27;)):                            │
│      if p.is_file():                                                         │
│          files.append(p.relative_to(input_dir))                              │
│  return files                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ def placeholder_layout_for_index(idx: int) -> List[str]: """ Placeholder     │
│ deterministic layout generator.                                              │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Given a flat index, return a list of path components to place the           │
│  file/chunk under. The final implementation must ensure that no              │
│  directory ends up with more than MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR children.              │
│  For now this returns a single-level folder named by the index //            │
│  MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR so that early testing of manifest behavior is           │
│  possible.                                                                   │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  level0 = idx // MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR                                         │
│  return [f&quot;shard-{level0:05d}&quot;]                                    │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ def split_and_write_file(src: Path, dst_base: Path, rel_out_path: Path,      │
│ manifest_entry: Dict[str, Any]) -> None: """ Split src into pieces not       │
│ exceeding MAX_FILE_BYTES and write them under dst_base/rel_out_path (which   │
│ is a relative path to the chunk prefix). Record chunk metadata into          │
│ manifest_entry['chunks'].                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  This skeleton writes the file un-split (single chunk) and records           │
│  sha256 and size. The full splitting logic will be implemented later.        │

│ def enumerate_input_files(input_dir: Path) -> List[Path]: """Return a list   │
│ of file paths (relative to input_dir) to process.                            │

│ def placeholder_layout_for_index(idx: int, total_files: int) -> List[str]:   │
│ """ Deterministic layout generator using base-N encoding.                    │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │

│ def placeholder_layout_for_index(idx: int, total_files: int) -> List[str]:   │
│ """ Deterministic layout generator using base-N encoding.                    │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Given a flat index and total number of files, return a list of              │
│  path components so that each directory will have at most                    │

│  directory levels needed and encodes idx in base MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR.        │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  import math                                                                 │
│  base = MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR                                                  │
│  if total_files &lt;= 0:                                                     │
│      width = 1                                                               │
│  else:                                                                       │
│      width = max(1, math.ceil(math.log(max(1, total_files), base)))          │
│  # represent idx in base `base` with `width` digits (big-endian)             │
│  digits = []                                                                 │
│  rem = idx                                                                   │
│  powers = [base ** i for i in range(width-1, -1, -1)]                        │

│      rem = rem % pwr                                                         │
│      digits.append(d)                                                        │

│                                                                              │
│ Why this is the next reasonable step                                         │
│                                                                              │
│  • compress.py now produces an invertible layout and writes chunk metadata   │
│    (size + sha256) to manifest.json. To satisfy the user's requirement that  │
│    decompression "reconstruct the original file structure and content        │
│    exactly", decompress.py must implement checksum-verified concatenation    │
│    and atomic writes and be validated with a >15MB test file.                │
│                                                                              │
│ High-level plan sketch                                                       │
│                                                                              │
│  1 Update decompress.py to reassemble entries:                               │
│     • Load manifest.json and iterate manifest["entries"].                    │
│     • For each entry, create parent directories for the original path if     │
│       needed.                                                                │
│     • For each chunk listed (in order):                                      │
│        • Locate chunk file under the resharded root using the recorded       │
│          relative chunk path.                                                │
│        • Validate chunk file size and sha256 against the manifest (fail with │
│          a clear error if mismatch).                                         │
│        • Stream the chunk bytes into a temporary output file (write in       │

│     • After all chunks are appended, verify the total size matches the       │
│       manifest entry size.                                                   │
│     • Atomically rename the temporary file to the original path (os.replace) │
│       to avoid partial writes.                                               │
│     • Support safe overwrite semantics (default overwrite, but use           │
│       temp+replace to keep atomicity).                                       │

│     • Print progress summaries, per-file success/failure messages, and an    │

│     • Exit nonzero on unrecoverable errors.                                  │

│       pattern or use a seeded PRNG) in /app/test_large_input.                │
│     • Run python /app/src/resharder/compress.py /app/test_large_input        │
│       /app/resharded_test_large to generate chunked output and manifest.     │
│     • Ensure manifest shows multiple chunk entries for the synthetic file.   │
│     • Run python /app/src/resharder/decompress.py /app/resharded_test_large  │
│       to reconstruct files in-place (or into a restore directory if you      │
│       prefer).                                                               │
│     • Compare original and reconstructed files using sha256; assert          │
│       equality.                                                              │
│     • Report test result and leave artifacts for inspection.                 │
│  4 Minimal safety/performance considerations:                                │
│     • Use streaming reads/writes and incremental hashlib.sha256 to avoid     │

│ def ensure_dir(path: Path) -> None: path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)  │

│ def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with             │
│ path.open('rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):          │
│ h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()                                         │

│ def enumerate_input_files(input_dir: Path) -> List[Path]: files = [] #       │
│ deterministic order for p in sorted(input_dir.rglob('*')): if p.is_file():   │
│ files.append(p.relative_to(input_dir)) return files                          │

│ def placeholder_layout_for_index(idx: int, total_files: int) -> List[str]:   │
│ """ Deterministic layout generator using base-N encoding. Encodes idx into   │
│ base MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR producing N directory components named shard-<dd>.  │
│ The width is chosen to accommodate total_files. """ import math base =       │
│ MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR if total_files <= 0: width = 1 else: width = max(1,      │
│ math.ceil(math.log(max(1, total_files), base))) digits = [] rem = idx powers │
│ = [base ** i for i in range(width-1, -1, -1)] for pwr in powers: d = rem //  │
│ pwr rem = rem % pwr digits.append(d) return [f"shard-{d:02d}" for d in       │
│ digits]                                                                      │

│ def split_and_write_file(src: Path, dst_base: Path, rel_out_path: Path,      │

│  manifest_entry.setdefault(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, [])                           │
│  total_written = 0                                                           │
│  with src.open(&#x27;rb&#x27;) as fr:                                        │
│      while True:                                                             │
│          data = fr.read(MAX_FILE_BYTES)                                      │
│          if not data:                                                        │
│              break                                                           │
│          chunk_name = f&quot;{rel_out_path.name}.part{part_idx:03d}&quot;    │
│          tmp_name = chunk_name + &#x27;.tmp&#x27;                            │
│          final_path = dst_base / chunk_name                                  │
│          tmp_path = dst_base / tmp_name                                      │
│          # write atomically to tmp then replace                              │
│          with tmp_path.open(&#x27;wb&#x27;) as fw:                           │
│              fw.write(data)                                                  │
│              fw.flush()                                                      │
│              os.fsync(fw.fileno())                                           │
│          os.replace(str(tmp_path), str(final_path))                          │
│          sha = compute_sha256(final_path)                                    │
│          manifest_entry[&#x27;chunks&#x27;].append({                         │
│              &#x27;path&#x27;: str(Path(rel_out_path.parent) / chunk_name),  │
│              &#x27;size&#x27;: final_path.stat().st_size,                    │
│              &#x27;sha256&#x27;: sha,                                        │
│          })                                                                  │
│          total_written += len(data)                                          │
│          part_idx += 1                                                       │
│  # total size sanity check already stored by caller                          │
│  return                                                                      │

│          the temp file into the original location (so reconstruction is      │
│          atomic and safe).                                                   │
│        • Prints per-file restore messages and a summary with counts of       │
│          restored files and failures.                                        │
│     • Kept and used the existing compress implementation in                  │
│       /app/src/resharder/compress.py                                         │
│        • Deterministic layout generator (base-N encoding with N =            │
│          MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR = 30) creates nested shard directories named    │
│          shard-XX.                                                           │
│        • Splits files into chunks <= 15 MB named <originalname>.partNNN,     │
│          writes them atomically (write to .tmp then os.replace), records     │
│          size and sha256 for every chunk.                                    │
│        • Writes manifest.json to output_dir with the following structure: {  │
│          "version": 1, "created_by": "compress.py", "root_input": "<absolute │
│          input dir>", "entries": [ { "original_path":                        │
│          "relative/path/from_input_dir", "size": <original_size_bytes>,      │
│          "chunks": [ { "path": "relative/path/in/output_dir/chunk0", "size": │
│          <bytes>, "sha256": "..." }, ... ] }, ... ] }                        │
│     • Added top-level wrapper scripts for easy invocation:                   │
│        • /app/compress.py — runs the implementation in src.                  │
│        • /app/decompress.py — runs the implementation in src.                │
│     • Added (and ran) an integration test at /app/integration_test.py which: │
│        • Creates a deterministic 17 MiB file                                 │
│          (/app/test_large_input/bigfile.bin),                                │
│        • Runs compress to produce multiple chunks and manifest,              │
│        • Removes the original file,                                          │
│        • Runs decompress to reassemble,                                      │
│        • Verifies the reconstructed file matches the original by sha256.     │

│ Notes, design choices, and safety                                            │
│                                                                              │
│  • Deterministic layout:                                                     │
│     • Uses base-30 encoding of the file index to form a fixed number of      │
│       shard directory components named shard-XX (XX zero-padded). This       │
│       guarantees <= 30 entries per directory and is invertible because the   │
│       manifest records each chunk path.                                      │
│  • Chunk naming:                                                             │
│     • chunk files are named <originalname>.partNNN with NNN zero-padded.     │
│  • Manifest:                                                                 │
│     • Records relative chunk paths under the output root, per-chunk size and │
│       sha256. Decompress uses these to verify chunk integrity before         │
│       concatenation and verifies the final reassembled size.                 │
│  • Atomic operations:                                                        │
│     • Both chunk writes and final reassembled writes are written to          │
│       temporary files and atomically moved into final names (os.replace).    │
│       File writes are fsynced after write.                                   │
│  • Streaming I/O:                                                            │
│     • All copying, splitting, and reassembly are streaming-based to avoid    │
│       large memory usage (works for large files).                            │
│  • Overwrite behavior:                                                       │
│     • Decompress will reconstruct files at the path recorded in              │
│       manifest.root_input if possible, otherwise in the current working      │
│       directory. It creates necessary parent directories. Existing files are │
│       atomically replaced by the reconstructed file (safe because of         │
│       temp+replace).                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ Where things are on disk                                                     │

│ def ensure_dir(path: Path) -> None: path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)  │
│                                                                              │
│ def compute_sha256_bytes(b: bytes) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() h.update(b)  │
│ return h.hexdigest()                                                         │

│ def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with             │
│ path.open('rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):          │
│ h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()                                         │

│ def enumerate_input_files(input_dir: Path) -> List[Path]: files = [] #       │
│ deterministic order for p in sorted(input_dir.rglob('*')): if p.is_file():   │
│ files.append(p.relative_to(input_dir)) return files                          │

│ def placeholder_layout_for_index(idx: int, total_files: int) -> List[str]:   │
│ """ Deterministic layout generator using base-N encoding. Encodes idx into   │
│ base MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR producing N directory components named shard-<dd>.  │
│ The width is chosen to accommodate total_files. """ import math base =       │
│ MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR if total_files <= 0: width = 1 else: width = max(1,      │
│ math.ceil(math.log(max(1, total_files), base))) digits = [] rem = idx powers │
│ = [base ** i for i in range(width-1, -1, -1)] for pwr in powers: d = rem //  │
│ pwr rem = rem % pwr digits.append(d) return [f"shard-{d:02d}" for d in       │
│ digits]                                                                      │

│ def split_and_write_file(src: Path, dst_base: Path, rel_out_path: Path,      │
│ manifest_entry: Dict[str, Any]) -> None: """ Split src into pieces not       │
│ exceeding MAX_FILE_BYTES and write them under dst_base (which corresponds to │
│ output_root/<rel_out_path.parent>). Record chunk metadata into               │
│ manifest_entry['chunks'].                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Chunk files are named: &lt;originalname&gt;.partNNN (NNN zero-padded)       │
│  and manifest paths are relative to the output root (e.g.                    │
│  &quot;shard-00/.../file.part000&quot;).                                     │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  ensure_dir(dst_base)                                                        │
│  part_idx = 0                                                                │
│  manifest_entry.setdefault(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, [])                           │
│  total_written = 0                                                           │
│  with src.open(&#x27;rb&#x27;) as fr:                                        │
│      while True:                                                             │
│          data = fr.read(MAX_FILE_BYTES)                                      │
│          if not data:                                                        │
│              break                                                           │
│          chunk_name = f&quot;{rel_out_path.name}.part{part_idx:03d}&quot;    │
│          tmp_name = chunk_name + &#x27;.tmp&#x27;                            │
│          final_path = dst_base / chunk_name                                  │
│          tmp_path = dst_base / tmp_name                                      │
│          # write atomically to tmp then replace                              │
│          with tmp_path.open(&#x27;wb&#x27;) as fw:                           │
│              fw.write(data)                                                  │
│              fw.flush()                                                      │
│              os.fsync(fw.fileno())                                           │
│          os.replace(str(tmp_path), str(final_path))                          │
│          sha = compute_sha256(final_path)                                    │
│          manifest_entry[&#x27;chunks&#x27;].append({                         │
│              &#x27;path&#x27;: str(Path(rel_out_path.parent) / chunk_name),  │
│              &#x27;size&#x27;: final_path.stat().st_size,                    │
│              &#x27;sha256&#x27;: sha,                                        │
│          })                                                                  │
│          total_written += len(data)                                          │
│          part_idx += 1                                                       │
│  # total size sanity check already stored by caller                          │
│  return                                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ def write_manifest(manifest: Dict[str, Any], out_manifest_path: Path) ->     │
│ None: ensure_dir(out_manifest_path.parent) with out_manifest_path.open('w',  │
│ encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(manifest, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) │
│                                                                              │

│ import sys import json import os import hashlib from pathlib import Path     │
│ from typing import Dict, Any import tempfile                                 │
│                                                                              │
│ def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with             │

│ h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()                                         │

│ def load_manifest(manifest_path: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]: with               │
│ manifest_path.open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f: return json.load(f)          │
│                                                                              │
│ def reassemble_entry(entry: Dict[str, Any], resharded_dir: Path,             │
│ reconstructed_root: Path) -> None: """Reassemble a single manifest entry     │
│ into its original path.                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Steps:                                                                      │
│  - For each chunk in entry[&#x27;chunks&#x27;] (ordered), locate the chunk   │
│  file under                                                                  │
│    resharded_dir / chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;] and validate size+sha256.         │
│  - Stream-concatenate chunks into a temporary file in the destination        │
│    directory, fsync and atomically rename into place.                        │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  orig_rel = entry[&#x27;original_path&#x27;]                                 │
│  dest = reconstructed_root / orig_rel                                        │
│  dest_parent = dest.parent                                                   │
│  dest_parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                              │
│                                                                              │
│  # Create a unique temp file in the destination directory to ensure atomic   │
│  move stays on same FS                                                       │
│  fd, tmp_path_str = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=&#x27;.tmp-decompress-&#x27;,    │
│  dir=str(dest_parent))                                                       │
│  os.close(fd)                                                                │
│  tmp_path = Path(tmp_path_str)                                               │
│                                                                              │
│  try:                                                                        │
│      with tmp_path.open(&#x27;wb&#x27;) as outf:                             │
│          # Iterate chunks                                                    │
│          total_written = 0                                                   │
│          for chunk in entry.get(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, []):                     │
│              chunk_rel = Path(chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;])                       │
│              chunk_path = resharded_dir / chunk_rel                          │
│              if not chunk_path.exists():                                     │
│                  raise FileNotFoundError(f&quot;Chunk file missing:          │
│  {chunk_path}&quot;)                                                         │
│              expected_size = int(chunk.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))            │
│              actual_size = chunk_path.stat().st_size                         │
│              if expected_size != -1 and actual_size != expected_size:        │
│                  raise ValueError(f&quot;Chunk size mismatch for             │
│  {chunk_path}: manifest {expected_size} != actual {actual_size}&quot;)       │
│              # validate sha256                                               │
│              expected_sha = chunk.get(&#x27;sha256&#x27;)                    │
│              if expected_sha:                                                │
│                  actual_sha = compute_sha256(chunk_path)                     │
│                  if actual_sha != expected_sha:                              │
│                      raise ValueError(f&quot;Chunk sha256 mismatch for       │
│  {chunk_path}: manifest {expected_sha} != actual {actual_sha}&quot;)         │
│              # stream copy                                                   │
│              with chunk_path.open(&#x27;rb&#x27;) as inf:                    │
│                  for data in iter(lambda: inf.read(1024*1024),               │
│  b&quot;&quot;):                                                             │
│                      outf.write(data)                                        │
│                      total_written += len(data)                              │
│          outf.flush()                                                        │
│          os.fsync(outf.fileno())                                             │
│                                                                              │
│      expected_total = int(entry.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))                   │
│      if expected_total != -1 and total_written != expected_total:            │
│          raise ValueError(f&quot;Reassembled size mismatch for {dest}:       │
│  manifest {expected_total} != assembled {total_written}&quot;)               │
│                                                                              │
│      # Atomically replace destination                                        │
│      os.replace(str(tmp_path), str(dest))                                    │
│      print(f&quot;Restored: {dest} ({total_written} bytes)&quot;)            │
│  except Exception:                                                           │
│      # Clean up temp file on error                                           │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          if tmp_path.exists():                                               │
│              tmp_path.unlink()                                               │
│      except Exception:                                                       │
│          pass                                                                │
│      raise                                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ def main(argv: list) -> int: if len(argv) != 2: print("Usage: python         │
│ /app/decompress.py <resharded_dir>") return 2                                │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  resharded_dir = Path(argv[1]).resolve()                                     │
│  if not resharded_dir.exists() or not resharded_dir.is_dir():                │
│      print(f&quot;Resharded directory does not exist or is not a directory:  │
│  {resharded_dir}&quot;)                                                      │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │

│                                                                              │
│  • Add a --verify-only (or -v) mode to /app/src/resharder/decompress.py (and │

│ Why this is the next reasonable step                                         │
│                                                                              │
│  • The pipeline already supports chunking and verified reassembly. A         │
│    lightweight verification mode lets the user check a resharded directory   │
│    for corruption or missing chunks before attempting a full reassembly      │
│    (safer and faster). It's small, self-contained, and directly leverages    │
│    the manifest/sha256 metadata already produced by compress.py.             │
│                                                                              │
│ High-level plan sketch                                                       │
│                                                                              │
│  1 CLI: add a boolean flag --verify-only (short -v) to the existing          │
│    decompress CLI. When present, skip reassembly and run verification        │
│    routine instead.                                                          │
│  2 Load manifest:                                                            │
│     • Open and parse output_dir/manifest.json (reuse existing                │
│       load_manifest()).                                                      │

│                                                                              │

│                                                                              │

│ def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with             │
│ path.open('rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):          │
│ h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()                                         │

│ def load_manifest(manifest_path: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]: with               │

│ def reassemble_entry(entry: Dict[str, Any], resharded_dir: Path,             │

│ into its original path.                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Steps:                                                                      │
│  - For each chunk in entry[&#x27;chunks&#x27;] (ordered), locate the chunk   │
│  file under                                                                  │
│    resharded_dir / chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;] and validate size+sha256.         │
│  - Stream-concatenate chunks into a temporary file in the destination        │

│  orig_rel = entry[&#x27;original_path&#x27;]                                 │

│              chunk_rel = Path(chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;])                       │
│              chunk_path = resharded_dir / chunk_rel                          │
│              if not chunk_path.exists():                                     │
│                  raise FileNotFoundError(f&quot;Chunk file missing:          │

│              if expected_size != -1 and actual_size != expected_size:        │

│                                                                              │
│      # Atomically replace destination                                        │

│      try:                                                                    │

│      except Exception:                                                       │
│          pass                                                                │

│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │

│ parser.parse_args(argv[1:])                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  resharded_dir = Path(args.resharded_dir).resolve()                          │
│  if not resharded_dir.exists() or not resharded_dir.is_dir():                │
│      print(f&quot;Resharded directory does not exist or is not a directory:  │
│  {resharded_dir}&quot;)                                                      │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  manifest_path = resharded_dir / &#x27;manifest.json&#x27;                   │
│  if not manifest_path.exists():                                              │
│      print(f&quot;Manifest not found in resharded directory:                 │
│  {manifest_path}&quot;)                                                      │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  manifest = load_manifest(manifest_path)                                     │
│  entries = manifest.get(&#x27;entries&#x27;, [])                             │
│  print(f&quot;Loaded manifest with {len(entries)} entries&quot;)             │
│                                                                              │
│  # Determine reconstructed root                                              │
│  if args.restore_root:                                                       │
│      reconstructed_root = Path(args.restore_root).resolve()                  │
│  elif args.inplace:                                                          │

│                                                                              │
│  print(f&quot;Done. Restored {len(entries)-failures} files, {failures}       │
│  failures. Restored files are under: {reconstructed_root}&quot;)             │

│ <output> #!/usr/bin/env python3 """ compress.py                              │
│                                                                              │
│ Reshards files from an input directory into an output directory with the     │
│ constraints:                                                                 │
│                                                                              │
│  • max 30 files or folders per directory                                     │
│  • max 15MB per output file (files larger than this are split into ordered   │
│    chunk files)                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ Usage: python /app/compress.py <input_dir> <output_dir>                      │
│                                                                              │
│ Manifest format (written to output_dir/manifest.json): { "version": 1,       │
│ "created_by": "compress.py", "root_input": "<absolute input dir>",           │
│ "entries": [ { "original_path": "relative/path/from_input_dir", "size":      │
│ <original_size_bytes>, "chunks": [ { "path":                                 │
│ "relative/path/in/output_dir/chunk0", "size": <bytes>, "sha256": "..." },    │
│ ... ] } ] } """                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ import sys import os import json import hashlib from pathlib import Path     │
│ from typing import List, Dict, Any                                           │
│                                                                              │
│ MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR = 30 MAX_FILE_BYTES = 15 * 1024 * 1024  # 15 MB          │
│                                                                              │
│ def ensure_dir(path: Path) -> None: path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)  │
│                                                                              │
│ def compute_sha256_bytes(b: bytes) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() h.update(b)  │
│ return h.hexdigest()                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with             │
│ path.open('rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):          │
│ h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ def enumerate_input_files(input_dir: Path) -> List[Path]: files = [] #       │
│ deterministic order for p in sorted(input_dir.rglob('*')): if p.is_file():   │
│ files.append(p.relative_to(input_dir)) return files                          │
│                                                                              │
│ def placeholder_layout_for_index(idx: int, total_files: int) -> List[str]:   │
│ """ Deterministic layout generator using base-N encoding. Encodes idx into   │
│ base MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR producing N directory components named shard-<dd>.  │
│ The width is chosen to accommodate total_files. """ import math base =       │
│ MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR if total_files <= 0: width = 1 else: width = max(1,      │
│ math.ceil(math.log(max(1, total_files), base))) digits = [] rem = idx powers │
│ = [base ** i for i in range(width-1, -1, -1)] for pwr in powers: d = rem //  │
│ pwr rem = rem % pwr digits.append(d) return [f"shard-{d:02d}" for d in       │
│ digits]                                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│ def split_and_write_file(src: Path, dst_base: Path, rel_out_path: Path,      │
│ manifest_entry: Dict[str, Any]) -> None: """ Split src into pieces not       │
│ exceeding MAX_FILE_BYTES and write them under dst_base (which corresponds to │
│ output_root/<rel_out_path.parent>). Record chunk metadata into               │
│ manifest_entry['chunks'].                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Chunk files are named: &lt;originalname&gt;.partNNN (NNN zero-padded)       │
│  and manifest paths are relative to the output root (e.g.                    │
│  &quot;shard-00/.../file.part000&quot;).                                     │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  ensure_dir(dst_base)                                                        │
│  part_idx = 0                                                                │
│  manifest_entry.setdefault(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, [])                           │
│  total_written = 0                                                           │
│  with src.open(&#x27;rb&#x27;) as fr:                                        │
│      while True:                                                             │
│          data = fr.read(MAX_FILE_BYTES)                                      │
│          if not data:                                                        │
│              break                                                           │
│          chunk_name = f&quot;{rel_out_path.name}.part{part_idx:03d}&quot;    │
│          tmp_name = chunk_name + &#x27;.tmp&#x27;                            │
│          final_path = dst_base / chunk_name                                  │
│          tmp_path = dst_base / tmp_name                                      │
│          # write atomically to tmp then replace                              │
│          with tmp_path.open(&#x27;wb&#x27;) as fw:                           │
│              fw.write(data)                                                  │
│              fw.flush()                                                      │
│              os.fsync(fw.fileno())                                           │
│          os.replace(str(tmp_path), str(final_path))                          │
│          sha = compute_sha256(final_path)                                    │
│          manifest_entry[&#x27;chunks&#x27;].append({                         │
│              &#x27;path&#x27;: str(Path(rel_out_path.parent) / chunk_name),  │
│              &#x27;size&#x27;: final_path.stat().st_size,                    │
│              &#x27;sha256&#x27;: sha,                                        │
│          })                                                                  │
│          total_written += len(data)                                          │
│          part_idx += 1                                                       │
│  # total size sanity check already stored by caller                          │
│  return                                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ def write_manifest(manifest: Dict[str, Any], out_manifest_path: Path) ->     │
│ None: ensure_dir(out_manifest_path.parent) with out_manifest_path.open('w',  │
│ encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(manifest, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) │
│                                                                              │
│ def main(argv: List[str]) -> int: if len(argv) != 3: print("Usage: python    │
│ /app/compress.py <input_dir> <output_dir>") return 2                         │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  input_dir = Path(argv[1]).resolve()                                         │
│  output_dir = Path(argv[2]).resolve()                                        │
│                                                                              │
│  if not input_dir.exists() or not input_dir.is_dir():                        │
│      print(f&quot;Input directory does not exist or is not a directory:      │
│  {input_dir}&quot;)                                                          │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  ensure_dir(output_dir)                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│  print(f&quot;Input: {input_dir}&quot;)                                      │
│  print(f&quot;Output: {output_dir}&quot;)                                    │
│                                                                              │
│  files = enumerate_input_files(input_dir)                                    │
│  print(f&quot;Found {len(files)} files to process&quot;)                     │
│                                                                              │
│  manifest: Dict[str, Any] = {                                                │
│      &#x27;version&#x27;: 1,                                                 │
│      &#x27;created_by&#x27;: &#x27;compress.py&#x27;,                        │
│      &#x27;root_input&#x27;: str(input_dir),                                 │
│      &#x27;entries&#x27;: []                                                 │
│  }                                                                           │
│                                                                              │
│  for idx, rel_path in enumerate(files):                                      │
│      src = input_dir / rel_path                                              │
│      entry: Dict[str, Any] = {                                               │
│          &#x27;original_path&#x27;: str(rel_path),                           │
│          &#x27;size&#x27;: src.stat().st_size,                               │
│          &#x27;chunks&#x27;: [],                                             │
│      }                                                                       │
│      components = placeholder_layout_for_index(idx, len(files))              │
│      target_dir = Path(*components)                                          │
│      rel_out_path = target_dir / rel_path.name                               │
│      full_target_dir = output_dir / target_dir                               │
│      split_and_write_file(src, full_target_dir, rel_out_path, entry)         │
│      manifest[&#x27;entries&#x27;].append(entry)                             │
│                                                                              │
│  write_manifest(manifest, output_dir / &#x27;manifest.json&#x27;)            │
│  print(f&quot;Wrote manifest with {len(manifest[&#x27;entries&#x27;])}       │
│  entries to {output_dir / &#x27;manifest.json&#x27;}&quot;)                  │
│  return 0                                                                    │

│ import sys import os import json import hashlib from pathlib import Path     │
│ from typing import List, Dict, Any                                           │

│ def ensure_dir(path: Path) -> None: path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)  │
│                                                                              │
│ def compute_sha256_bytes(b: bytes) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() h.update(b)  │
│ return h.hexdigest()                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with             │
│ path.open('rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):          │
│ h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()                                         │

│ def enumerate_input_files(input_dir: Path) -> List[Path]: files = [] #       │
│ deterministic order for p in sorted(input_dir.rglob('*')): if p.is_file():   │
│ files.append(p.relative_to(input_dir)) return files                          │

│ def placeholder_layout_for_index(idx: int, total_files: int) -> List[str]:   │
│ """ Deterministic layout generator using base-N encoding. Encodes idx into   │
│ base MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR producing N directory components named shard-<dd>.  │
│ The width is chosen to accommodate total_files. """ import math base =       │
│ MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR if total_files <= 0: width = 1 else: width = max(1,      │
│ math.ceil(math.log(max(1, total_files), base))) digits = [] rem = idx powers │
│ = [base ** i for i in range(width-1, -1, -1)] for pwr in powers: d = rem //  │
│ pwr rem = rem % pwr digits.append(d) return [f"shard-{d:02d}" for d in       │
│ digits]                                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│ def split_and_write_file(src: Path, dst_base: Path, rel_out_path: Path,      │
│ manifest_entry: Dict[str, Any]) -> None: """ Split src into pieces not       │
│ exceeding MAX_FILE_BYTES and write them under dst_base (which corresponds to │
│ output_root/<rel_out_path.parent>). Record chunk metadata into               │
│ manifest_entry['chunks'].                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Chunk files are named: &lt;originalname&gt;.partNNN (NNN zero-padded)       │
│  and manifest paths are relative to the output root (e.g.                    │
│  &quot;shard-00/.../file.part000&quot;).                                     │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  ensure_dir(dst_base)                                                        │
│  part_idx = 0                                                                │
│  manifest_entry.setdefault(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, [])                           │
│  total_written = 0                                                           │
│  with src.open(&#x27;rb&#x27;) as fr:                                        │
│      while True:                                                             │
│          data = fr.read(MAX_FILE_BYTES)                                      │
│          if not data:                                                        │
│              break                                                           │
│          chunk_name = f&quot;{rel_out_path.name}.part{part_idx:03d}&quot;    │
│          tmp_name = chunk_name + &#x27;.tmp&#x27;                            │
│          final_path = dst_base / chunk_name                                  │
│          tmp_path = dst_base / tmp_name                                      │
│          # write atomically to tmp then replace                              │
│          with tmp_path.open(&#x27;wb&#x27;) as fw:                           │
│              fw.write(data)                                                  │
│              fw.flush()                                                      │
│              os.fsync(fw.fileno())                                           │
│          os.replace(str(tmp_path), str(final_path))                          │
│          sha = compute_sha256(final_path)                                    │
│          manifest_entry[&#x27;chunks&#x27;].append({                         │
│              &#x27;path&#x27;: str(Path(rel_out_path.parent) / chunk_name),  │
│              &#x27;size&#x27;: final_path.stat().st_size,                    │
│              &#x27;sha256&#x27;: sha,                                        │
│          })                                                                  │
│          total_written += len(data)                                          │
│          part_idx += 1                                                       │
│  # total size sanity check already stored by caller                          │
│  return                                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ def write_manifest(manifest: Dict[str, Any], out_manifest_path: Path) ->     │
│ None: ensure_dir(out_manifest_path.parent) with out_manifest_path.open('w',  │
│ encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(manifest, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) │

│ <output> #!/usr/bin/env python3 """ decompress.py                            │
│                                                                              │
│ Usage: python /app/decompress.py <resharded_dir> [--restore-root PATH]       │
│ [--inplace]                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│ This script loads the manifest.json in the resharded directory and           │
│ reconstructs the original files and directory structure.                     │
│                                                                              │
│ By default it writes restored files into <resharded_dir>/restored/           │
│ (non-destructive). Use --inplace to write directly into the resharded_dir    │
│ (overwrite possible). Use --restore-root to specify a custom restoration     │

│                                                                              │

│                                                                              │
│ import sys import json import os import hashlib from pathlib import Path     │
│ import tempfile import argparse from typing import Dict, Any                 │
│                                                                              │
│ def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with             │
│ path.open('rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):          │
│ h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ def load_manifest(manifest_path: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]: with               │
│ manifest_path.open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f: return json.load(f)          │
│                                                                              │
│ def reassemble_entry(entry: Dict[str, Any], resharded_dir: Path,             │
│ reconstructed_root: Path) -> None: """Reassemble a single manifest entry     │
│ into its original path.                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Steps:                                                                      │
│  - For each chunk in entry[&#x27;chunks&#x27;] (ordered), locate the chunk   │
│  file under                                                                  │
│    resharded_dir / chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;] and validate size+sha256.         │
│  - Stream-concatenate chunks into a temporary file in the destination        │
│    directory, fsync and atomically rename into place.                        │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  orig_rel = entry[&#x27;original_path&#x27;]                                 │
│  dest = reconstructed_root / orig_rel                                        │
│  dest_parent = dest.parent                                                   │
│  dest_parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                              │
│                                                                              │
│  # Create a unique temp file in the destination directory to ensure atomic   │
│  move stays on same FS                                                       │
│  fd, tmp_path_str = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=&#x27;.tmp-decompress-&#x27;,    │
│  dir=str(dest_parent))                                                       │
│  os.close(fd)                                                                │
│  tmp_path = Path(tmp_path_str)                                               │
│                                                                              │
│  try:                                                                        │
│      with tmp_path.open(&#x27;wb&#x27;) as outf:                             │
│          # Iterate chunks                                                    │
│          total_written = 0                                                   │
│          for chunk in entry.get(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, []):                     │
│              chunk_rel = Path(chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;])                       │
│              chunk_path = resharded_dir / chunk_rel                          │
│              if not chunk_path.exists():                                     │
│                  raise FileNotFoundError(f&quot;Chunk file missing:          │
│  {chunk_path}&quot;)                                                         │
│              expected_size = int(chunk.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))            │
│              actual_size = chunk_path.stat().st_size                         │
│              if expected_size != -1 and actual_size != expected_size:        │
│                  raise ValueError(f&quot;Chunk size mismatch for             │
│  {chunk_path}: manifest {expected_size} != actual {actual_size}&quot;)       │
│              # validate sha256                                               │
│              expected_sha = chunk.get(&#x27;sha256&#x27;)                    │
│              if expected_sha:                                                │
│                  actual_sha = compute_sha256(chunk_path)                     │
│                  if actual_sha != expected_sha:                              │
│                      raise ValueError(f&quot;Chunk sha256 mismatch for       │
│  {chunk_path}: manifest {expected_sha} != actual {actual_sha}&quot;)         │
│              # stream copy                                                   │
│              with chunk_path.open(&#x27;rb&#x27;) as inf:                    │
│                  for data in iter(lambda: inf.read(1024*1024),               │
│  b&quot;&quot;):                                                             │
│                      outf.write(data)                                        │
│                      total_written += len(data)                              │
│          outf.flush()                                                        │
│          os.fsync(outf.fileno())                                             │
│                                                                              │
│      expected_total = int(entry.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))                   │
│      if expected_total != -1 and total_written != expected_total:            │
│          raise ValueError(f&quot;Reassembled size mismatch for {dest}:       │
│  manifest {expected_total} != assembled {total_written}&quot;)               │
│                                                                              │
│      # Atomically replace destination                                        │
│      os.replace(str(tmp_path), str(dest))                                    │
│      print(f&quot;Restored: {dest} ({total_written} bytes)&quot;)            │
│  except Exception:                                                           │
│      # Clean up temp file on error                                           │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          if tmp_path.exists():                                               │
│              tmp_path.unlink()                                               │
│      except Exception:                                                       │
│          pass                                                                │
│      raise                                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ def main(argv: list) -> int: parser =                                        │
│ argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Reassemble files from a resharded       │
│ directory using its manifest.') parser.add_argument('resharded_dir',         │
│ help='Path to the resharded directory (must contain manifest.json)')         │
│ parser.add_argument('--restore-root', '-r', help='Optional path to write     │
│ restored files into. If omitted, defaults to <resharded_dir>/restored')      │
│ parser.add_argument('--inplace', action='store_true', help='Write restored   │
│ files directly into the resharded directory (use with care)')                │
│ parser.add_argument('--verify-only', '-v', action='store_true', help='Only   │
│ verify chunk existence/size/sha256 according to the manifest and do not      │
│ reassemble') args = parser.parse_args(argv[1:])                              │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  resharded_dir = Path(args.resharded_dir).resolve()                          │
│  if not resharded_dir.exists() or not resharded_dir.is_dir():                │
│      print(f&quot;Resharded directory does not exist or is not a directory:  │
│  {resharded_dir}&quot;)                                                      │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  manifest_path = resharded_dir / &#x27;manifest.json&#x27;                   │
│  if not manifest_path.exists():                                              │
│      print(f&quot;Manifest not found in resharded directory:                 │
│  {manifest_path}&quot;)                                                      │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  manifest = load_manifest(manifest_path)                                     │
│  entries = manifest.get(&#x27;entries&#x27;, [])                             │
│  print(f&quot;Loaded manifest with {len(entries)} entries&quot;)             │
│                                                                              │
│  # If verify-only was requested, run the verification routine and exit       │
│  if args.verify_only:                                                        │
│      ok = True                                                               │
│      total_chunks = 0                                                        │
│      missing = 0                                                             │
│      size_mismatches = 0                                                     │
│      sha_mismatches = 0                                                      │
│      sample_issues = []                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│      for entry in entries:                                                   │
│          for chunk in entry.get(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, []):                     │
│              total_chunks += 1                                               │
│              chunk_rel = Path(chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;])                       │
│              chunk_path = resharded_dir / chunk_rel                          │
│              if not chunk_path.exists():                                     │
│                  missing += 1                                                │
│                  sample_issues.append(f&quot;MISSING: {chunk_path}&quot;)    │
│                  ok = False                                                  │
│                  continue                                                    │
│              expected_size = int(chunk.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))            │
│              actual_size = chunk_path.stat().st_size                         │
│              if expected_size != -1 and actual_size != expected_size:        │
│                  size_mismatches += 1                                        │
│                  sample_issues.append(f&quot;SIZE-MISMATCH: {chunk_path}     │
│  manifest={expected_size} actual={actual_size}&quot;)                        │
│                  ok = False                                                  │
│                  # still compute sha to surface both problems                │
│              expected_sha = chunk.get(&#x27;sha256&#x27;)                    │
│              if expected_sha:                                                │
│                  actual_sha = compute_sha256(chunk_path)                     │
│                  if actual_sha != expected_sha:                              │
│                      sha_mismatches += 1                                     │
│                      sample_issues.append(f&quot;SHA-MISMATCH: {chunk_path}  │
│  manifest={expected_sha} actual={actual_sha}&quot;)                          │
│                      ok = False                                              │
│                                                                              │
│      print(&quot;Verification summary:&quot;)                                │
│      print(f&quot;  total chunks: {total_chunks}&quot;)                      │
│      print(f&quot;  missing: {missing}&quot;)                                │
│      print(f&quot;  size mismatches: {size_mismatches}&quot;)                │
│      print(f&quot;  sha mismatches: {sha_mismatches}&quot;)                  │
│      if sample_issues:                                                       │
│          print(&#x27;\nSample issues:&#x27;)                                 │
│          for s in sample_issues[:50]:                                        │
│              print(&#x27; &#x27;, s)                                         │
│                                                                              │
│      return 0 if ok else 2                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│  # Determine reconstructed root                                              │
│  if args.restore_root:                                                       │
│      reconstructed_root = Path(args.restore_root).resolve()                  │
│  elif args.inplace:                                                          │
│      reconstructed_root = resharded_dir                                      │
│  else:                                                                       │
│      reconstructed_root = resharded_dir / &#x27;restored&#x27;               │
│                                                                              │
│  try:                                                                        │
│      reconstructed_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                   │
│  except Exception as e:                                                      │
│      print(f&quot;Failed to create reconstruction root                       │
│  {reconstructed_root}: {e}&quot;)                                            │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  failures = 0                                                                │
│  for entry in entries:                                                       │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          reassemble_entry(entry, resharded_dir, reconstructed_root)          │
│      except Exception as e:                                                  │
│          failures += 1                                                       │
│          print(f&quot;Failed to restore                                      │
│  {entry.get(&#x27;original_path&#x27;)}: {e}&quot;)                          │
│                                                                              │
│  print(f&quot;Done. Restored {len(entries)-failures} files, {failures}       │
│  failures. Restored files are under: {reconstructed_root}&quot;)             │
│  return 1 if failures else 0                                                 │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ if name == 'main': raise SystemExit(main(sys.argv)) </output>                │

│ <output> #!/usr/bin/env python3 """ compress.py                              │
│                                                                              │
│ Reshards files from an input directory into an output directory with the     │
│ constraints:                                                                 │
│                                                                              │
│  • max 30 files or folders per directory                                     │
│  • max 15MB per output file (files larger than this are split into ordered   │
│    chunk files)                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ Usage: python /app/compress.py <input_dir> <output_dir>                      │
│                                                                              │
│ Manifest format (written to output_dir/manifest.json): { "version": 1,       │
│ "created_by": "compress.py", "root_input": "<absolute input dir>",           │
│ "entries": [ { "original_path": "relative/path/from_input_dir", "size":      │
│ <original_size_bytes>, "chunks": [ { "path":                                 │
