│ ... ] } ] } """                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ import sys import os import json import hashlib from pathlib import Path     │
│ from typing import List, Dict, Any                                           │
│                                                                              │
│ MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR = 30 MAX_FILE_BYTES = 15 * 1024 * 1024  # 15 MB          │
│                                                                              │
│ def ensure_dir(path: Path) -> None: path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)  │
│                                                                              │
│ def compute_sha256_bytes(b: bytes) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() h.update(b)  │
│ return h.hexdigest()                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with             │
│ path.open('rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):          │
│ h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ def enumerate_input_files(input_dir: Path) -> List[Path]: files = [] #       │
│ deterministic order for p in sorted(input_dir.rglob('*')): if p.is_file():   │
│ files.append(p.relative_to(input_dir)) return files                          │
│                                                                              │
│ def placeholder_layout_for_index(idx: int, total_files: int) -> List[str]:   │
│ """ Deterministic layout generator using base-N encoding. Encodes idx into   │
│ base MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR producing N directory components named shard-<dd>.  │
│ The width is chosen to accommodate total_files. """ import math base =       │
│ MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR if total_files <= 0: width = 1 else: width = max(1,      │
│ math.ceil(math.log(max(1, total_files), base))) digits = [] rem = idx powers │
│ = [base ** i for i in range(width-1, -1, -1)] for pwr in powers: d = rem //  │
│ pwr rem = rem % pwr digits.append(d) return [f"shard-{d:02d}" for d in       │
│ digits]                                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│ def split_and_write_file(src: Path, dst_base: Path, rel_out_path: Path,      │
│ manifest_entry: Dict[str, Any]) -> None: """ Split src into pieces not       │
│ exceeding MAX_FILE_BYTES and write them under dst_base (which corresponds to │
│ output_root/<rel_out_path.parent>). Record chunk metadata into               │
│ manifest_entry['chunks'].                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Chunk files are named: &lt;originalname&gt;.partNNN (NNN zero-padded)       │
│  and manifest paths are relative to the output root (e.g.                    │
│  &quot;shard-00/.../file.part000&quot;).                                     │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  ensure_dir(dst_base)                                                        │
│  part_idx = 0                                                                │
│  manifest_entry.setdefault(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, [])                           │
│  total_written = 0                                                           │
│  with src.open(&#x27;rb&#x27;) as fr:                                        │
│      while True:                                                             │
│          data = fr.read(MAX_FILE_BYTES)                                      │
│          if not data:                                                        │
│              break                                                           │
│          chunk_name = f&quot;{rel_out_path.name}.part{part_idx:03d}&quot;    │
│          tmp_name = chunk_name + &#x27;.tmp&#x27;                            │
│          final_path = dst_base / chunk_name                                  │
│          tmp_path = dst_base / tmp_name                                      │
│          # write atomically to tmp then replace                              │
│          with tmp_path.open(&#x27;wb&#x27;) as fw:                           │
│              fw.write(data)                                                  │
│              fw.flush()                                                      │
│              os.fsync(fw.fileno())                                           │
│          os.replace(str(tmp_path), str(final_path))                          │
│          sha = compute_sha256(final_path)                                    │
│          manifest_entry[&#x27;chunks&#x27;].append({                         │
│              &#x27;path&#x27;: str(Path(rel_out_path.parent) / chunk_name),  │
│              &#x27;size&#x27;: final_path.stat().st_size,                    │
│              &#x27;sha256&#x27;: sha,                                        │
│          })                                                                  │
│          total_written += len(data)                                          │
│          part_idx += 1                                                       │
│  # total size sanity check already stored by caller                          │
│  return                                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ def write_manifest(manifest: Dict[str, Any], out_manifest_path: Path) ->     │
│ None: ensure_dir(out_manifest_path.parent) with out_manifest_path.open('w',  │
│ encoding='utf-8') as f: json.dump(manifest, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) │
│                                                                              │

│          # store sample mapping info                                         │

│  f&quot;{rel_path.name}.part{pi:03d}&quot;) for pi in range(min(chunks,      │
│  5))]                                                                        │
│          simulate.append((str(rel_path), size, chunks, sample_chunks))       │
│                                                                              │
│      # compute max entries per directory                                     │
│      max_entries = 0                                                         │
│      for d, children in dir_children.items():                                │

│      print(&quot;--- Dry-run summary ---&quot;)                              │

│      print(f&quot;Total estimated chunks: {total_chunks}&quot;)              │
│      # infer layout width                                                    │
│      import math                                                             │
│      width = max(1, math.ceil(math.log(max(1, len(files)),                   │
│  MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR)))                                                      │
│      print(f&quot;Computed shard depth (levels): {width}&quot;)              │
│      top_level = sorted({placeholder_layout_for_index(i, len(files))[0] for  │
│  i in range(len(files))})                                                    │
│      print(f&quot;Top-level shard count: {len(top_level)}&quot;)             │
│      print(f&quot;Max entries in any simulated directory: {max_entries}      │
│  (limit {MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR})&quot;)                                        │
│      print(&quot;&quot;)                                                     │
│                                                                              │

│ <output> #!/usr/bin/env python3 """ decompress.py                            │
│                                                                              │
│ Usage: python /app/decompress.py <resharded_dir> [--restore-root PATH]       │
│ [--inplace]                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│ This script loads the manifest.json in the resharded directory and           │
│ reconstructs the original files and directory structure.                     │
│                                                                              │
│ By default it writes restored files into <resharded_dir>/restored/           │
│ (non-destructive). Use --inplace to write directly into the resharded_dir    │
│ (overwrite possible). Use --restore-root to specify a custom restoration     │
│ root.                                                                        │
│                                                                              │
│ It validates chunk file sizes and sha256 checksums and writes files          │
│ atomically using a temporary file and os.replace. """                        │
│                                                                              │
│ import sys import json import os import hashlib from pathlib import Path     │
│ import tempfile import argparse from typing import Dict, Any                 │
│                                                                              │
│ def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with             │
│ path.open('rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):          │
│ h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ def load_manifest(manifest_path: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]: with               │
│ manifest_path.open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f: return json.load(f)          │
│                                                                              │
│ def reassemble_entry(entry: Dict[str, Any], resharded_dir: Path,             │
│ reconstructed_root: Path) -> None: """Reassemble a single manifest entry     │
│ into its original path.                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Steps:                                                                      │
│  - For each chunk in entry[&#x27;chunks&#x27;] (ordered), locate the chunk   │
│  file under                                                                  │
│    resharded_dir / chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;] and validate size+sha256.         │
│  - Stream-concatenate chunks into a temporary file in the destination        │
│    directory, fsync and atomically rename into place.                        │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  orig_rel = entry[&#x27;original_path&#x27;]                                 │
│  dest = reconstructed_root / orig_rel                                        │
│  dest_parent = dest.parent                                                   │
│  dest_parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                              │
│                                                                              │
│  # Create a unique temp file in the destination directory to ensure atomic   │
│  move stays on same FS                                                       │
│  fd, tmp_path_str = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=&#x27;.tmp-decompress-&#x27;,    │
│  dir=str(dest_parent))                                                       │
│  os.close(fd)                                                                │
│  tmp_path = Path(tmp_path_str)                                               │
│                                                                              │
│  try:                                                                        │
│      with tmp_path.open(&#x27;wb&#x27;) as outf:                             │
│          # Iterate chunks                                                    │
│          total_written = 0                                                   │
│          for chunk in entry.get(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, []):                     │
│              chunk_rel = Path(chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;])                       │
│              chunk_path = resharded_dir / chunk_rel                          │
│              if not chunk_path.exists():                                     │
│                  raise FileNotFoundError(f&quot;Chunk file missing:          │
│  {chunk_path}&quot;)                                                         │
│              expected_size = int(chunk.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))            │
│              actual_size = chunk_path.stat().st_size                         │
│              if expected_size != -1 and actual_size != expected_size:        │
│                  raise ValueError(f&quot;Chunk size mismatch for             │
│  {chunk_path}: manifest {expected_size} != actual {actual_size}&quot;)       │
│              # validate sha256                                               │
│              expected_sha = chunk.get(&#x27;sha256&#x27;)                    │
│              if expected_sha:                                                │
│                  actual_sha = compute_sha256(chunk_path)                     │
│                  if actual_sha != expected_sha:                              │
│                      raise ValueError(f&quot;Chunk sha256 mismatch for       │
│  {chunk_path}: manifest {expected_sha} != actual {actual_sha}&quot;)         │
│              # stream copy                                                   │
│              with chunk_path.open(&#x27;rb&#x27;) as inf:                    │
│                  for data in iter(lambda: inf.read(1024*1024),               │
│  b&quot;&quot;):                                                             │
│                      outf.write(data)                                        │
│                      total_written += len(data)                              │
│          outf.flush()                                                        │
│          os.fsync(outf.fileno())                                             │
│                                                                              │
│      expected_total = int(entry.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))                   │
│      if expected_total != -1 and total_written != expected_total:            │
│          raise ValueError(f&quot;Reassembled size mismatch for {dest}:       │
│  manifest {expected_total} != assembled {total_written}&quot;)               │
│                                                                              │
│      # Atomically replace destination                                        │
│      os.replace(str(tmp_path), str(dest))                                    │
│      print(f&quot;Restored: {dest} ({total_written} bytes)&quot;)            │
│  except Exception:                                                           │
│      # Clean up temp file on error                                           │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          if tmp_path.exists():                                               │
│              tmp_path.unlink()                                               │
│      except Exception:                                                       │
│          pass                                                                │
│      raise                                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ def main(argv: list) -> int: parser =                                        │
│ argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Reassemble files from a resharded       │
│ directory using its manifest.') parser.add_argument('resharded_dir',         │
│ help='Path to the resharded directory (must contain manifest.json)')         │
│ parser.add_argument('--restore-root', '-r', help='Optional path to write     │
│ restored files into. If omitted, defaults to <resharded_dir>/restored')      │
│ parser.add_argument('--inplace', action='store_true', help='Write restored   │

│ parser.add_argument('--verify-only', '-v', action='store_true', help='Only   │
│ verify chunk existence/size/sha256 according to the manifest and do not      │

│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  resharded_dir = Path(args.resharded_dir).resolve()                          │
│  if not resharded_dir.exists() or not resharded_dir.is_dir():                │
│      print(f&quot;Resharded directory does not exist or is not a directory:  │
│  {resharded_dir}&quot;)                                                      │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  manifest_path = resharded_dir / &#x27;manifest.json&#x27;                   │
│  if not manifest_path.exists():                                              │
│      print(f&quot;Manifest not found in resharded directory:                 │
│  {manifest_path}&quot;)                                                      │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  manifest = load_manifest(manifest_path)                                     │
│  entries = manifest.get(&#x27;entries&#x27;, [])                             │
│  print(f&quot;Loaded manifest with {len(entries)} entries&quot;)             │
│                                                                              │
│  # If verify-only was requested, run the verification routine and exit       │
│  if args.verify_only:                                                        │
│      ok = True                                                               │
│      total_chunks = 0                                                        │
│      missing = 0                                                             │
│      size_mismatches = 0                                                     │
│      sha_mismatches = 0                                                      │
│      sample_issues = []                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│      for entry in entries:                                                   │
│          for chunk in entry.get(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, []):                     │
│              total_chunks += 1                                               │
│              chunk_rel = Path(chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;])                       │
│              chunk_path = resharded_dir / chunk_rel                          │
│              if not chunk_path.exists():                                     │
│                  missing += 1                                                │
│                  sample_issues.append(f&quot;MISSING: {chunk_path}&quot;)    │
│                  ok = False                                                  │

│              expected_size = int(chunk.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))            │
│              actual_size = chunk_path.stat().st_size                         │
│              if expected_size != -1 and actual_size != expected_size:        │

│                  ok = False                                                  │
│                  # still compute sha to surface both problems                │
│              expected_sha = chunk.get(&#x27;sha256&#x27;)                    │
│              if expected_sha:                                                │
│                  actual_sha = compute_sha256(chunk_path)                     │
│                  if actual_sha != expected_sha:                              │
│                      sha_mismatches += 1                                     │
│                      sample_issues.append(f&quot;SHA-MISMATCH: {chunk_path}  │
│  manifest={expected_sha} actual={actual_sha}&quot;)                          │
│                      ok = False                                              │
│                                                                              │
│      print(&quot;Verification summary:&quot;)                                │
│      print(f&quot;  total chunks: {total_chunks}&quot;)                      │
│      print(f&quot;  missing: {missing}&quot;)                                │
│      print(f&quot;  size mismatches: {size_mismatches}&quot;)                │
│      print(f&quot;  sha mismatches: {sha_mismatches}&quot;)                  │
│      if sample_issues:                                                       │
│          print(&#x27;\nSample issues:&#x27;)                                 │
│          for s in sample_issues[:50]:                                        │
│              print(&#x27; &#x27;, s)                                         │
│                                                                              │
│      return 0 if ok else 2                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│  # Determine reconstructed root                                              │
│  if args.restore_root:                                                       │
│      reconstructed_root = Path(args.restore_root).resolve()                  │
│  elif args.inplace:                                                          │
│      reconstructed_root = resharded_dir                                      │
│  else:                                                                       │
│      reconstructed_root = resharded_dir / &#x27;restored&#x27;               │
│                                                                              │
│  try:                                                                        │
│      reconstructed_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                   │
│  except Exception as e:                                                      │
│      print(f&quot;Failed to create reconstruction root                       │
│  {reconstructed_root}: {e}&quot;)                                            │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  failures = 0                                                                │
│  for entry in entries:                                                       │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          reassemble_entry(entry, resharded_dir, reconstructed_root)          │
│      except Exception as e:                                                  │
│          failures += 1                                                       │
│          print(f&quot;Failed to restore                                      │
│  {entry.get(&#x27;original_path&#x27;)}: {e}&quot;)                          │
│                                                                              │
│  print(f&quot;Done. Restored {len(entries)-failures} files, {failures}       │
│  failures. Restored files are under: {reconstructed_root}&quot;)             │
│  return 1 if failures else 0                                                 │

│ <output> #!/usr/bin/env python3 """ compress.py                              │
│                                                                              │
│ Reshards files from an input directory into an output directory with the     │
│ constraints:                                                                 │
│                                                                              │
│  • max 30 files or folders per directory                                     │
│  • max 15MB per output file (files larger than this are split into ordered   │
│    chunk files)                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ Usage: python /app/compress.py <input_dir> <output_dir>                      │
│                                                                              │
│ Manifest format (written to output_dir/manifest.json): { "version": 1,       │
│ "created_by": "compress.py", "root_input": "<absolute input dir>",           │
│ "entries": [ { "original_path": "relative/path/from_input_dir", "size":      │
│ <original_size_bytes>, "chunks": [ { "path":                                 │
│ "relative/path/in/output_dir/chunk0", "size": <bytes>, "sha256": "..." },    │
│ ... ] } ] } """                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ import sys import os import json import hashlib from pathlib import Path     │
│ from typing import List, Dict, Any                                           │
│                                                                              │
│ MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR = 30 MAX_FILE_BYTES = 15 * 1024 * 1024  # 15 MB          │
│                                                                              │
│ def ensure_dir(path: Path) -> None: path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)  │
│                                                                              │
│ def compute_sha256_bytes(b: bytes) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() h.update(b)  │
│ return h.hexdigest()                                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with             │
│ path.open('rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):          │
│ h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ def enumerate_input_files(input_dir: Path) -> List[Path]: files = [] #       │
│ deterministic order for p in sorted(input_dir.rglob('*')): if p.is_file():   │
│ files.append(p.relative_to(input_dir)) return files                          │
│                                                                              │
│ def placeholder_layout_for_index(idx: int, total_files: int) -> List[str]:   │
│ """ Deterministic layout generator using base-N encoding. Encodes idx into   │
│ base MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR producing N directory components named shard-<dd>.  │
│ The width is chosen to accommodate total_files. """ import math base =       │
│ MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR if total_files <= 0: width = 1 else: width = max(1,      │
│ math.ceil(math.log(max(1, total_files), base))) digits = [] rem = idx powers │
│ = [base ** i for i in range(width-1, -1, -1)] for pwr in powers: d = rem //  │
│ pwr rem = rem % pwr digits.append(d) return [f"shard-{d:02d}" for d in       │
│ digits]                                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│ def split_and_write_file(src: Path, dst_base: Path, rel_out_path: Path,      │
│ manifest_entry: Dict[str, Any]) -> None: """ Split src into pieces not       │
│ exceeding MAX_FILE_BYTES and write them under dst_base (which corresponds to │
│ output_root/<rel_out_path.parent>). Record chunk metadata into               │
│ manifest_entry['chunks'].                                                    │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Chunk files are named: &lt;originalname&gt;.partNNN (NNN zero-padded)       │
│  and manifest paths are relative to the output root (e.g.                    │
│  &quot;shard-00/.../file.part000&quot;).                                     │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  ensure_dir(dst_base)                                                        │
│  part_idx = 0                                                                │
│  manifest_entry.setdefault(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, [])                           │
│  total_written = 0                                                           │
│  with src.open(&#x27;rb&#x27;) as fr:                                        │
│      while True:                                                             │
│          data = fr.read(MAX_FILE_BYTES)                                      │
│          if not data:                                                        │
│              break                                                           │
│          chunk_name = f&quot;{rel_out_path.name}.part{part_idx:03d}&quot;    │
│          tmp_name = chunk_name + &#x27;.tmp&#x27;                            │
│          final_path = dst_base / chunk_name                                  │
│          tmp_path = dst_base / tmp_name                                      │
│          # write atomically to tmp then replace                              │
│          with tmp_path.open(&#x27;wb&#x27;) as fw:                           │
│              fw.write(data)                                                  │
│              fw.flush()                                                      │
│              os.fsync(fw.fileno())                                           │
│          os.replace(str(tmp_path), str(final_path))                          │
│          sha = compute_sha256(final_path)                                    │
│          manifest_entry[&#x27;chunks&#x27;].append({                         │
│              &#x27;path&#x27;: str(Path(rel_out_path.parent) / chunk_name),  │
│              &#x27;size&#x27;: final_path.stat().st_size,                    │
│              &#x27;sha256&#x27;: sha,                                        │
│          })                                                                  │
│          total_written += len(data)                                          │
│          part_idx += 1                                                       │
│  # total size sanity check already stored by caller                          │
│  return                                                                      │
│                                                                              │

│ def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with             │
│ path.open('rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):          │
│ h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()                                         │

│ manifest_path.open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f: return json.load(f)          │

│ def reassemble_entry(entry: Dict[str, Any], resharded_dir: Path,             │
│ reconstructed_root: Path) -> None: """Reassemble a single manifest entry     │
│ into its original path.                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Steps:                                                                      │
│  - For each chunk in entry[&#x27;chunks&#x27;] (ordered), locate the chunk   │
│  file under                                                                  │
│    resharded_dir / chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;] and validate size+sha256.         │
│  - Stream-concatenate chunks into a temporary file in the destination        │
│    directory, fsync and atomically rename into place.                        │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  orig_rel = entry[&#x27;original_path&#x27;]                                 │
│  dest = reconstructed_root / orig_rel                                        │
│  dest_parent = dest.parent                                                   │
│  dest_parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                              │
│                                                                              │
│  # Create a unique temp file in the destination directory to ensure atomic   │
│  move stays on same FS                                                       │
│  fd, tmp_path_str = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=&#x27;.tmp-decompress-&#x27;,    │
│  dir=str(dest_parent))                                                       │
│  os.close(fd)                                                                │
│  tmp_path = Path(tmp_path_str)                                               │
│                                                                              │
│  try:                                                                        │
│      with tmp_path.open(&#x27;wb&#x27;) as outf:                             │
│          # Iterate chunks                                                    │
│          total_written = 0                                                   │
│          for chunk in entry.get(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, []):                     │
│              chunk_rel = Path(chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;])                       │
│              chunk_path = resharded_dir / chunk_rel                          │
│              if not chunk_path.exists():                                     │
│                  raise FileNotFoundError(f&quot;Chunk file missing:          │
│  {chunk_path}&quot;)                                                         │
│              expected_size = int(chunk.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))            │
│              actual_size = chunk_path.stat().st_size                         │
│              if expected_size != -1 and actual_size != expected_size:        │
│                  raise ValueError(f&quot;Chunk size mismatch for             │
│  {chunk_path}: manifest {expected_size} != actual {actual_size}&quot;)       │
│              # validate sha256                                               │
│              expected_sha = chunk.get(&#x27;sha256&#x27;)                    │
│              if expected_sha:                                                │
│                  actual_sha = compute_sha256(chunk_path)                     │
│                  if actual_sha != expected_sha:                              │
│                      raise ValueError(f&quot;Chunk sha256 mismatch for       │
│  {chunk_path}: manifest {expected_sha} != actual {actual_sha}&quot;)         │
│              # stream copy                                                   │
│              with chunk_path.open(&#x27;rb&#x27;) as inf:                    │
│                  for data in iter(lambda: inf.read(1024*1024),               │
│  b&quot;&quot;):                                                             │
│                      outf.write(data)                                        │
│                      total_written += len(data)                              │
│          outf.flush()                                                        │
│          os.fsync(outf.fileno())                                             │
│                                                                              │
│      expected_total = int(entry.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))                   │
│      if expected_total != -1 and total_written != expected_total:            │
│          raise ValueError(f&quot;Reassembled size mismatch for {dest}:       │
│  manifest {expected_total} != assembled {total_written}&quot;)               │
│                                                                              │
│      # Atomically replace destination                                        │
│      os.replace(str(tmp_path), str(dest))                                    │
│      print(f&quot;Restored: {dest} ({total_written} bytes)&quot;)            │
│  except Exception:                                                           │
│      # Clean up temp file on error                                           │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          if tmp_path.exists():                                               │
│              tmp_path.unlink()                                               │
│      except Exception:                                                       │
│          pass                                                                │
│      raise                                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │

│ Usage: python /app/decompress.py <resharded_dir> [--restore-root PATH]       │
│ [--inplace]                                                                  │
│                                                                              │

│ By default it writes restored files into <resharded_dir>/restored/           │
│ (non-destructive). Use --inplace to write directly into the resharded_dir    │

│                                                                              │
│ import sys import json import os import hashlib from pathlib import Path     │
│ import tempfile import argparse from typing import Dict, Any                 │
│                                                                              │
│ def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with             │
│ path.open('rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):          │
│ h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ def load_manifest(manifest_path: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]: with               │
│ manifest_path.open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f: return json.load(f)          │
│                                                                              │
│ def reassemble_entry(entry: Dict[str, Any], resharded_dir: Path,             │
│ reconstructed_root: Path) -> None: """Reassemble a single manifest entry     │
│ into its original path.                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Steps:                                                                      │
│  - For each chunk in entry[&#x27;chunks&#x27;] (ordered), locate the chunk   │
│  file under                                                                  │
│    resharded_dir / chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;] and validate size+sha256.         │
│  - Stream-concatenate chunks into a temporary file in the destination        │
│    directory, fsync and atomically rename into place.                        │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  orig_rel = entry[&#x27;original_path&#x27;]                                 │
│  dest = reconstructed_root / orig_rel                                        │
│  dest_parent = dest.parent                                                   │
│  dest_parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                              │
│                                                                              │
│  # Create a unique temp file in the destination directory to ensure atomic   │
│  move stays on same FS                                                       │
│  fd, tmp_path_str = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=&#x27;.tmp-decompress-&#x27;,    │
│  dir=str(dest_parent))                                                       │
│  os.close(fd)                                                                │
│  tmp_path = Path(tmp_path_str)                                               │
│                                                                              │
│  try:                                                                        │
│      with tmp_path.open(&#x27;wb&#x27;) as outf:                             │
│          # Iterate chunks                                                    │
│          total_written = 0                                                   │
│          for chunk in entry.get(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, []):                     │
│              chunk_rel = Path(chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;])                       │
│              chunk_path = resharded_dir / chunk_rel                          │
│              if not chunk_path.exists():                                     │
│                  raise FileNotFoundError(f&quot;Chunk file missing:          │
│  {chunk_path}&quot;)                                                         │
│              expected_size = int(chunk.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))            │
│              actual_size = chunk_path.stat().st_size                         │
│              if expected_size != -1 and actual_size != expected_size:        │
│                  raise ValueError(f&quot;Chunk size mismatch for             │
│  {chunk_path}: manifest {expected_size} != actual {actual_size}&quot;)       │
│              # validate sha256                                               │
│              expected_sha = chunk.get(&#x27;sha256&#x27;)                    │
│              if expected_sha:                                                │
│                  actual_sha = compute_sha256(chunk_path)                     │
│                  if actual_sha != expected_sha:                              │
│                      raise ValueError(f&quot;Chunk sha256 mismatch for       │
│  {chunk_path}: manifest {expected_sha} != actual {actual_sha}&quot;)         │
│              # stream copy                                                   │
│              with chunk_path.open(&#x27;rb&#x27;) as inf:                    │
│                  for data in iter(lambda: inf.read(1024*1024),               │
│  b&quot;&quot;):                                                             │
│                      outf.write(data)                                        │
│                      total_written += len(data)                              │
│          outf.flush()                                                        │
│          os.fsync(outf.fileno())                                             │
│                                                                              │
│      expected_total = int(entry.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))                   │
│      if expected_total != -1 and total_written != expected_total:            │
│          raise ValueError(f&quot;Reassembled size mismatch for {dest}:       │
│  manifest {expected_total} != assembled {total_written}&quot;)               │
│                                                                              │
│      # Atomically replace destination                                        │
│      os.replace(str(tmp_path), str(dest))                                    │
│      print(f&quot;Restored: {dest} ({total_written} bytes)&quot;)            │
│  except Exception:                                                           │
│      # Clean up temp file on error                                           │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          if tmp_path.exists():                                               │
│              tmp_path.unlink()                                               │
│      except Exception:                                                       │
│          pass                                                                │
│      raise                                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ def main(argv: list) -> int: parser =                                        │
│ argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Reassemble files from a resharded       │
│ directory using its manifest.') parser.add_argument('resharded_dir',         │
│ help='Path to the resharded directory (must contain manifest.json)')         │
│ parser.add_argument('--restore-root', '-r', help='Optional path to write     │
│ restored files into. If omitted, defaults to <resharded_dir>/restored')      │
│ parser.add_argument('--inplace', action='store_true', help='Write restored   │

│ parser.add_argument('--verify-only', '-v', action='store_true', help='Only   │

│ reassemble') args = parser.parse_args(argv[1:])                              │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  resharded_dir = Path(args.resharded_dir).resolve()                          │
│  if not resharded_dir.exists() or not resharded_dir.is_dir():                │
│      print(f&quot;Resharded directory does not exist or is not a directory:  │
│  {resharded_dir}&quot;)                                                      │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  manifest_path = resharded_dir / &#x27;manifest.json&#x27;                   │
│  if not manifest_path.exists():                                              │

│  {manifest_path}&quot;)                                                      │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  manifest = load_manifest(manifest_path)                                     │
│  entries = manifest.get(&#x27;entries&#x27;, [])                             │
│  print(f&quot;Loaded manifest with {len(entries)} entries&quot;)             │
│                                                                              │
│  # If verify-only was requested, run the verification routine and exit       │
│  if args.verify_only:                                                        │
│      ok = True                                                               │
│      total_chunks = 0                                                        │
│      missing = 0                                                             │
│      size_mismatches = 0                                                     │
│      sha_mismatches = 0                                                      │
│      sample_issues = []                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│      for entry in entries:                                                   │
│          for chunk in entry.get(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, []):                     │
│              total_chunks += 1                                               │
│              chunk_rel = Path(chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;])                       │
│              chunk_path = resharded_dir / chunk_rel                          │
│              if not chunk_path.exists():                                     │
│                  missing += 1                                                │
│                  sample_issues.append(f&quot;MISSING: {chunk_path}&quot;)    │
│                  ok = False                                                  │
│                  continue                                                    │
│              expected_size = int(chunk.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))            │
│              actual_size = chunk_path.stat().st_size                         │
│              if expected_size != -1 and actual_size != expected_size:        │
│                  size_mismatches += 1                                        │
│                  sample_issues.append(f&quot;SIZE-MISMATCH: {chunk_path}     │
│  manifest={expected_size} actual={actual_size}&quot;)                        │
│                  ok = False                                                  │
│                  # still compute sha to surface both problems                │
│              expected_sha = chunk.get(&#x27;sha256&#x27;)                    │
│              if expected_sha:                                                │
│                  actual_sha = compute_sha256(chunk_path)                     │
│                  if actual_sha != expected_sha:                              │
│                      sha_mismatches += 1                                     │
│                      sample_issues.append(f&quot;SHA-MISMATCH: {chunk_path}  │
│  manifest={expected_sha} actual={actual_sha}&quot;)                          │
│                      ok = False                                              │
│                                                                              │
│      print(&quot;Verification summary:&quot;)                                │
│      print(f&quot;  total chunks: {total_chunks}&quot;)                      │
│      print(f&quot;  missing: {missing}&quot;)                                │
│      print(f&quot;  size mismatches: {size_mismatches}&quot;)                │
│      print(f&quot;  sha mismatches: {sha_mismatches}&quot;)                  │
│      if sample_issues:                                                       │
│          print(&#x27;\nSample issues:&#x27;)                                 │
│          for s in sample_issues[:50]:                                        │
│              print(&#x27; &#x27;, s)                                         │
│                                                                              │
│      return 0 if ok else 2                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│  # Determine reconstructed root                                              │
│  if args.restore_root:                                                       │
│      reconstructed_root = Path(args.restore_root).resolve()                  │
│  elif args.inplace:                                                          │
│      reconstructed_root = resharded_dir                                      │
│  else:                                                                       │
│      reconstructed_root = resharded_dir / &#x27;restored&#x27;               │
│                                                                              │
│  try:                                                                        │
│      reconstructed_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                   │
│  except Exception as e:                                                      │
│      print(f&quot;Failed to create reconstruction root                       │
│  {reconstructed_root}: {e}&quot;)                                            │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  failures = 0                                                                │
│  for entry in entries:                                                       │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          reassemble_entry(entry, resharded_dir, reconstructed_root)          │
│      except Exception as e:                                                  │
│          failures += 1                                                       │
│          print(f&quot;Failed to restore                                      │
│  {entry.get(&#x27;original_path&#x27;)}: {e}&quot;)                          │
│                                                                              │
│  print(f&quot;Done. Restored {len(entries)-failures} files, {failures}       │
│  failures. Restored files are under: {reconstructed_root}&quot;)             │
│  return 1 if failures else 0                                                 │
│                                                                              │

│ def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with             │
│ path.open('rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):          │
│ h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()                                         │

│ manifest_path.open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f: return json.load(f)          │

│ def reassemble_entry(entry: Dict[str, Any], resharded_dir: Path,             │
│ reconstructed_root: Path) -> None: """Reassemble a single manifest entry     │
│ into its original path.                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Steps:                                                                      │
│  - For each chunk in entry[&#x27;chunks&#x27;] (ordered), locate the chunk   │
│  file under                                                                  │
│    resharded_dir / chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;] and validate size+sha256.         │
│  - Stream-concatenate chunks into a temporary file in the destination        │
│    directory, fsync and atomically rename into place.                        │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  orig_rel = entry[&#x27;original_path&#x27;]                                 │
│  dest = reconstructed_root / orig_rel                                        │
│  dest_parent = dest.parent                                                   │
│  dest_parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                              │
│                                                                              │
│  # Create a unique temp file in the destination directory to ensure atomic   │
│  move stays on same FS                                                       │
│  fd, tmp_path_str = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=&#x27;.tmp-decompress-&#x27;,    │
│  dir=str(dest_parent))                                                       │
│  os.close(fd)                                                                │
│  tmp_path = Path(tmp_path_str)                                               │
│                                                                              │
│  try:                                                                        │
│      with tmp_path.open(&#x27;wb&#x27;) as outf:                             │
│          # Iterate chunks                                                    │
│          total_written = 0                                                   │
│          for chunk in entry.get(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, []):                     │
│              chunk_rel = Path(chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;])                       │
│              chunk_path = resharded_dir / chunk_rel                          │
│              if not chunk_path.exists():                                     │
│                  raise FileNotFoundError(f&quot;Chunk file missing:          │
│  {chunk_path}&quot;)                                                         │
│              expected_size = int(chunk.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))            │
│              actual_size = chunk_path.stat().st_size                         │
│              if expected_size != -1 and actual_size != expected_size:        │
│                  raise ValueError(f&quot;Chunk size mismatch for             │
│  {chunk_path}: manifest {expected_size} != actual {actual_size}&quot;)       │
│              # validate sha256                                               │

│              if expected_sha:                                                │

│                  if actual_sha != expected_sha:                              │

│          os.fsync(outf.fileno())                                             │
│                                                                              │

│      if expected_total != -1 and total_written != expected_total:            │
│          raise ValueError(f&quot;Reassembled size mismatch for {dest}:       │
│  manifest {expected_total} != assembled {total_written}&quot;)               │
│                                                                              │
│      # Atomically replace destination                                        │
│      os.replace(str(tmp_path), str(dest))                                    │
│      print(f&quot;Restored: {dest} ({total_written} bytes)&quot;)            │
│  except Exception:                                                           │
│      # Clean up temp file on error                                           │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          if tmp_path.exists():                                               │
│              tmp_path.unlink()                                               │
│      except Exception:                                                       │

│ <output> #!/usr/bin/env python3 """ decompress.py                            │
│                                                                              │
│ Usage: python /app/decompress.py <resharded_dir> [--restore-root PATH]       │
│ [--inplace]                                                                  │
│                                                                              │
│ This script loads the manifest.json in the resharded directory and           │
│ reconstructs the original files and directory structure.                     │
│                                                                              │
│ By default it writes restored files into <resharded_dir>/restored/           │
│ (non-destructive). Use --inplace to write directly into the resharded_dir    │
│ (overwrite possible). Use --restore-root to specify a custom restoration     │
│ root.                                                                        │
│                                                                              │
│ It validates chunk file sizes and sha256 checksums and writes files          │
│ atomically using a temporary file and os.replace. """                        │
│                                                                              │
│ import sys import json import os import hashlib from pathlib import Path     │
│ import tempfile import argparse from typing import Dict, Any                 │
│                                                                              │
│ def compute_sha256(path: Path) -> str: h = hashlib.sha256() with             │
│ path.open('rb') as f: for chunk in iter(lambda: f.read(8192), b""):          │
│ h.update(chunk) return h.hexdigest()                                         │
│                                                                              │
│ def load_manifest(manifest_path: Path) -> Dict[str, Any]: with               │
│ manifest_path.open('r', encoding='utf-8') as f: return json.load(f)          │
│                                                                              │
│ def reassemble_entry(entry: Dict[str, Any], resharded_dir: Path,             │
│ reconstructed_root: Path) -> None: """Reassemble a single manifest entry     │
│ into its original path.                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  Steps:                                                                      │
│  - For each chunk in entry[&#x27;chunks&#x27;] (ordered), locate the chunk   │
│  file under                                                                  │
│    resharded_dir / chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;] and validate size+sha256.         │
│  - Stream-concatenate chunks into a temporary file in the destination        │
│    directory, fsync and atomically rename into place.                        │
│  &quot;&quot;&quot;                                                          │
│  orig_rel = entry[&#x27;original_path&#x27;]                                 │
│  dest = reconstructed_root / orig_rel                                        │
│  dest_parent = dest.parent                                                   │
│  dest_parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                              │
│                                                                              │
│  # Create a unique temp file in the destination directory to ensure atomic   │
│  move stays on same FS                                                       │
│  fd, tmp_path_str = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=&#x27;.tmp-decompress-&#x27;,    │
│  dir=str(dest_parent))                                                       │
│  os.close(fd)                                                                │
│  tmp_path = Path(tmp_path_str)                                               │
│                                                                              │
│  try:                                                                        │
│      with tmp_path.open(&#x27;wb&#x27;) as outf:                             │
│          # Iterate chunks                                                    │
│          total_written = 0                                                   │
│          for chunk in entry.get(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, []):                     │
│              chunk_rel = Path(chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;])                       │
│              chunk_path = resharded_dir / chunk_rel                          │
│              if not chunk_path.exists():                                     │
│                  raise FileNotFoundError(f&quot;Chunk file missing:          │
│  {chunk_path}&quot;)                                                         │
│              expected_size = int(chunk.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))            │
│              actual_size = chunk_path.stat().st_size                         │
│              if expected_size != -1 and actual_size != expected_size:        │
│                  raise ValueError(f&quot;Chunk size mismatch for             │
│  {chunk_path}: manifest {expected_size} != actual {actual_size}&quot;)       │
│              # validate sha256                                               │
│              expected_sha = chunk.get(&#x27;sha256&#x27;)                    │
│              if expected_sha:                                                │
│                  actual_sha = compute_sha256(chunk_path)                     │
│                  if actual_sha != expected_sha:                              │
│                      raise ValueError(f&quot;Chunk sha256 mismatch for       │
│  {chunk_path}: manifest {expected_sha} != actual {actual_sha}&quot;)         │
│              # stream copy                                                   │
│              with chunk_path.open(&#x27;rb&#x27;) as inf:                    │
│                  for data in iter(lambda: inf.read(1024*1024),               │
│  b&quot;&quot;):                                                             │
│                      outf.write(data)                                        │
│                      total_written += len(data)                              │
│          outf.flush()                                                        │
│          os.fsync(outf.fileno())                                             │
│                                                                              │
│      expected_total = int(entry.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))                   │
│      if expected_total != -1 and total_written != expected_total:            │
│          raise ValueError(f&quot;Reassembled size mismatch for {dest}:       │
│  manifest {expected_total} != assembled {total_written}&quot;)               │
│                                                                              │
│      # Atomically replace destination                                        │
│      os.replace(str(tmp_path), str(dest))                                    │
│      print(f&quot;Restored: {dest} ({total_written} bytes)&quot;)            │
│  except Exception:                                                           │
│      # Clean up temp file on error                                           │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          if tmp_path.exists():                                               │
│              tmp_path.unlink()                                               │
│      except Exception:                                                       │
│          pass                                                                │
│      raise                                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│ def main(argv: list) -> int: parser =                                        │
│ argparse.ArgumentParser(description='Reassemble files from a resharded       │
│ directory using its manifest.') parser.add_argument('resharded_dir',         │
│ help='Path to the resharded directory (must contain manifest.json)')         │
│ parser.add_argument('--restore-root', '-r', help='Optional path to write     │
│ restored files into. If provided this overrides other flags')                │
│ parser.add_argument('--inplace', action='store_true', help='Write restored   │
│ files directly into the resharded directory (use with care)')                │
│ parser.add_argument('--safe', action='store_true', help='Non-destructive:    │
│ write restored files into <resharded_dir>/restored. Defaults to in-place     │
│ when not provided') parser.add_argument('--verify-only', '-v',               │
│ action='store_true', help='Only verify chunk existence/size/sha256 according │
│ to the manifest and do not reassemble') args = parser.parse_args(argv[1:])   │
│                                                                              │
│                                                                              │
│  resharded_dir = Path(args.resharded_dir).resolve()                          │
│  if not resharded_dir.exists() or not resharded_dir.is_dir():                │
│      print(f&quot;Resharded directory does not exist or is not a directory:  │
│  {resharded_dir}&quot;)                                                      │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  manifest_path = resharded_dir / &#x27;manifest.json&#x27;                   │
│  if not manifest_path.exists():                                              │
│      print(f&quot;Manifest not found in resharded directory:                 │
│  {manifest_path}&quot;)                                                      │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  manifest = load_manifest(manifest_path)                                     │
│  entries = manifest.get(&#x27;entries&#x27;, [])                             │
│  print(f&quot;Loaded manifest with {len(entries)} entries&quot;)             │
│                                                                              │
│  # If verify-only was requested, run the verification routine and exit       │
│  if args.verify_only:                                                        │
│      ok = True                                                               │
│      total_chunks = 0                                                        │
│      missing = 0                                                             │
│      size_mismatches = 0                                                     │
│      sha_mismatches = 0                                                      │
│      sample_issues = []                                                      │
│                                                                              │
│      for entry in entries:                                                   │
│          for chunk in entry.get(&#x27;chunks&#x27;, []):                     │
│              total_chunks += 1                                               │
│              chunk_rel = Path(chunk[&#x27;path&#x27;])                       │
│              chunk_path = resharded_dir / chunk_rel                          │
│              if not chunk_path.exists():                                     │
│                  missing += 1                                                │
│                  sample_issues.append(f&quot;MISSING: {chunk_path}&quot;)    │
│                  ok = False                                                  │
│                  continue                                                    │
│              expected_size = int(chunk.get(&#x27;size&#x27;, -1))            │
│              actual_size = chunk_path.stat().st_size                         │
│              if expected_size != -1 and actual_size != expected_size:        │
│                  size_mismatches += 1                                        │
│                  sample_issues.append(f&quot;SIZE-MISMATCH: {chunk_path}     │
│  manifest={expected_size} actual={actual_size}&quot;)                        │
│                  ok = False                                                  │
│                  # still compute sha to surface both problems                │
│              expected_sha = chunk.get(&#x27;sha256&#x27;)                    │
│              if expected_sha:                                                │
│                  actual_sha = compute_sha256(chunk_path)                     │
│                  if actual_sha != expected_sha:                              │
│                      sha_mismatches += 1                                     │
│                      sample_issues.append(f&quot;SHA-MISMATCH: {chunk_path}  │
│  manifest={expected_sha} actual={actual_sha}&quot;)                          │
│                      ok = False                                              │
│                                                                              │
│      print(&quot;Verification summary:&quot;)                                │
│      print(f&quot;  total chunks: {total_chunks}&quot;)                      │
│      print(f&quot;  missing: {missing}&quot;)                                │
│      print(f&quot;  size mismatches: {size_mismatches}&quot;)                │
│      print(f&quot;  sha mismatches: {sha_mismatches}&quot;)                  │
│      if sample_issues:                                                       │
│          print(&#x27;\nSample issues:&#x27;)                                 │
│          for s in sample_issues[:50]:                                        │
│              print(&#x27; &#x27;, s)                                         │
│                                                                              │
│      return 0 if ok else 2                                                   │
│                                                                              │
│  # Determine reconstructed root                                              │
│  # Behavior change: default is to restore in-place into the resharded_dir    │
│  # to match the user&#x27;s requested default. Use --safe to write into      │
│  # &lt;resharded_dir&gt;/restored (non-destructive), or --restore-root to    │
│  # specify an explicit restore location. --inplace forces in-place write.    │
│  if args.restore_root:                                                       │
│      reconstructed_root = Path(args.restore_root).resolve()                  │
│  elif args.inplace:                                                          │
│      reconstructed_root = resharded_dir                                      │
│  elif args.safe:                                                             │
│      reconstructed_root = resharded_dir / &#x27;restored&#x27;               │
│  else:                                                                       │
│      # default behaviour: in-place                                           │
│      reconstructed_root = resharded_dir                                      │
│                                                                              │
│  try:                                                                        │
│      reconstructed_root.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)                   │
│  except Exception as e:                                                      │
│      print(f&quot;Failed to create reconstruction root                       │
│  {reconstructed_root}: {e}&quot;)                                            │
│      return 1                                                                │
│                                                                              │
│  failures = 0                                                                │
│  for entry in entries:                                                       │
│      try:                                                                    │
│          reassemble_entry(entry, resharded_dir, reconstructed_root)          │
│      except Exception as e:                                                  │
│          failures += 1                                                       │
│          print(f&quot;Failed to restore                                      │
│  {entry.get(&#x27;original_path&#x27;)}: {e}&quot;)                          │
│                                                                              │
│  print(f&quot;Done. Restored {len(entries)-failures} files, {failures}       │
│  failures. Restored files are under: {reconstructed_root}&quot;)             │
│  return 1 if failures else 0                                                 │

│ by default. Deliverables: /app/compress.py and /app/decompress.py,           │
│ implemented, tested, and packaged for uv (pyproject.toml + .venv).\n\n-      │
│ Solution outline\n  - Deterministic, invertible layout: files enumerated in  │
│ sorted order; index → nested shard path via base-N encoding where N =        │
│ MAX_ENTRIES_PER_DIR (30). Directory names are shard-XX. The layout           │
│ guarantees every directory has ≤30 immediate entries.\n  - Chunking: files   │
│ are split into chunks ≤ 15 MiB (MAX_CHUNK_BYTES). Chunk filenames:           │
│ <originalname>.partNNN. Writes are atomic (.tmp → os.replace) and streaming  │
│ to avoid high memory use.\n  - Manifest: output_dir/manifest.json (JSON)     │
│ records version, created_by, root_input, and entries. Each entry has         │
│ original_path (relative), size, and ordered chunks with {path:               │
│ relative/path/in/output, size, sha256}.\n  - Reassembly: decompress loads    │
│ the manifest, verifies each chunk (exists, size, sha256), concatenates       │
│ chunks by streaming into a temp file, fsyncs, then atomically renames into   │
│ place.\n  - CLI extras: compress --dry-run (simulate layout & chunk counts), │
│ decompress --verify-only (check chunk existence/size/sha256 without          │
│ writing), --restore-root, --inplace, and a safe non-destructive restore mode │
│ (restored/).\n\n- Files added/updated\n  - /app/pyproject.toml (minimal;     │
│ uv-compatible)\n  - /app/compress.py and /app/decompress.py (top-level       │
│ wrappers)\n  - /app/src/resharder/compress.py (implementation)\n  -          │
│ /app/src/resharder/decompress.py (implementation)\n  -                       │
│ /app/integration_test.py (integration check used during development)\n\n-    │
│ Execution & testing\n  - Environment: Python 3.13.7; uv available. uv sync   │
│ in /app created the venv; uv run executes scripts without extra installs.\n  │
│ - c4_sample run: compress on /app/c4_sample produced /app/resharded_full     │
│ (9,898 files). Verified directory-tree constraint—no directory had >30       │
│ entries. Manifest with 9,898 entries written.\n  - verify-only: decompress   │
│ --verify-only on produced resharded dir reported zero missing/size/sha       │
│ mismatches.\n  - End-to-end: decompress (default in-place) restored files    │
│ directly into the resharded directory; programmatic SHA256 comparisons       │
│ confirmed restored files matched originals (all 9,898 matched).\n  -         │
│ Large-file integration: synthetic ~17 MiB file was compressed into multiple  │
│ chunks and reassembled; reconstructed file SHA256 matched original.\n  -     │
│ Dry-run: compress --dry-run simulates layout & chunk counts without writing; │
│ useful preview.\n  - uv workflow tested: uv sync and uv run executed         │
│ compress/decompress wrappers successfully.\n\n- Important implementation     │
│ details & safeguards\n  - Deterministic mapping + explicit manifest ensures  │
│ invertibility.\n  - Per-chunk SHA256 and sizes are recorded and verified;    │
│ reassembly fails fast on mismatches.\n  - Atomic writes via temp files and   │
│ os.replace prevent partial/corrupt files on interruption.\n  - Streaming     │
│ read/write and incremental hashing for memory efficiency.\n  - Default       │
│ decompress behavior changed per spec: running python /app/decompress.py      │
│ <resharded_dir> now restores in-place by default; --safe or --restore-root   │
│ are available for non-destructive or custom restore roots.\n\n- Key findings │
│ / lessons\n  - A manifest is essential to make a deterministic layout        │
│ practically invertible and robust across systems.\n  - Atomic writes and     │
│ chunk checksums are necessary to avoid and detect corruption during          │
│ transport or partial runs.\n  - A dry-run and verify-only modes are valuable │
│ for safety on large datasets before committing to writes.\n\n- How to run    │
│ (examples)\n  - Prepare venv: cd /app && uv sync\n  - Dry-run preview: uv    │
│ run -- python /app/compress.py /path/to/input /path/to/output --dry-run      │
│ --samples 5\n  - Real reshard: uv run -- python /app/compress.py             │
│ /path/to/input /path/to/output\n  - Verify shards: uv run -- python          │
│ /app/decompress.py /path/to/output --verify-only\n  - Restore in-place       │
│ (default): uv run -- python /app/decompress.py /path/to/output\n  - Restore  │
│ to custom root: uv run -- python /app/decompress.py /path/to/output          │
│ --restore-root /other/restore/path\n\nIf you want, I can:\n- Add a short     │
│ README with usage examples and recommended workflows,\n- Add optional        │
│ parallelism for faster processing,\n- Add a flag to remove shards after      │
│ successful in-place restore (dangerous; recommend manual cleanup).'          │
